summary: Verified public website, inquiry and site visit flows, admin and associate authentication, protected dashboards, lead assignment/status workflow, responsive mobile layout, and upload type validation.
action_items: Add browser coverage for reservation approval/booking and successful object-storage upload when storage is available.
critical_code_review_comments: Several implemented backend capabilities (bookings, documents/gallery/settings/reports) have no corresponding API/UI routes in this release and remain untested.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST-prefixed inquiry leads through the public API for workflow verification; no manual seeded records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public pages/forms, admin dashboard/leads, associate dashboard/leads, role isolation, mobile overflow, and invalid upload validation passed. Reservation/booking and successful storage upload remain uncovered.
rca of the issue: The initial browser attempt observed an empty properties list immediately after navigation, but a retry after a short wait rendered all four properties; this was transient API/UI loading timing rather than a reproducible defect.
